Wallet file exfiltration on compromised device — Malware or a local attacker steals the wallet file from the user device and recovers private keys.
Exchange API key stolen and abused — An attacker steals trading bot API keys (e.g., via MITM or log leakage) and issues unauthorized trades.
Malicious or spoofed ElectrumX feeds false blockchain data — A rogue or spoofed ElectrumX server provides incorrect balances/headers, leading the wallet to display or act on false state.
